_miss.title: Drop me on something
_miss.text: Drag the orb onto any part of the page, like a button, a picture or a link. I'll tell you what it does.

greeting.title: Your hello
greeting.text: This line says hello when you arrive. If you choose a nickname, it greets you by that name.
greeting.try: Tap 'Want me to call you something?' at the bottom and pick a name that feels like you.

name-prompt.title: Your nickname
name-prompt.text: You can give Rebella a nickname to call you. Up to 20 letters, spaces or hyphens. It stays in this browser on this device only. It is never sent to us or anyone else. 'Forget my name' wipes it straight away.
name-prompt.try: It's totally optional. Skip it if you'd rather stay a mystery.

cookies.title: Cookies and your device
cookies.text: Cookies are little notes a website saves in your browser. Rebella doesn't set any. It saves a couple of things on your device only, like your nickname and your mood board, and never sends them to us. Tap the link to read the whole story.
cookies.try: Open your browser's settings and find where it lists site data. It's like peeking in your own pocket.

nav.title: The section menu
nav.text: These are Rebella's sections. Each one is a different kind of reading: making things, big questions, books, feelings and more.
nav.try: Pick the one that pulls at you most today, not the one you think you should.

menu-burger.title: Menu button
menu-burger.text: On small screens the sections hide in here. Tap it to open the menu, and tap the X to close it.

search.title: Search
search.text: Type a word you're curious about to look for it on Rebella. Search is still being built, so for now it's a preview.

create-pill.title: Make a board
create-pill.text: Opens the Create page, where you can make a mood board, collage or vision board with stickers, photos and your own words.
create-pill.try: Make a board about a day that felt really good.

picks-link.title: Picks
picks-link.text: The Picks page has a song of the week, someone famous for the right reasons, a quote and a goal for everyone.
picks-link.try: Read the quote of the week and notice how it sits with you.

all-articles.title: All articles
all-articles.text: Every Rebella article in one list, sorted by section.

submit.title: Share your work
submit.text: Soon you'll be able to share your art, writing and projects. A grown-up editor checks everything first, to keep it safe and kind.

article-card.title: Article card
article-card.text: Each card is one article. The coloured band shows its section. Tap the picture or the title to read it.
article-card.try: Choose by the picture that catches your eye first.

fact-band.title: Fact band
fact-band.text: A band of quick, true facts that slide past. Each one is checked before it goes on Rebella.
fact-band.try: Spot a fact that makes you go 'wow' and tell someone about it.

quote.title: Rebel quote
quote.text: A quote from someone who did things their own way. It changes every time you load a page.
quote.try: Read it slowly, twice. Does it feel true for you?

stickers.title: Stickers
stickers.text: Original Rebella stickers. On the Create page you can drag them onto your board.
stickers.try: Pick the sticker that matches your mood right now.

weather-faces.title: Weather faces
weather-faces.text: Little faces that show the weather outside. They change slowly with the sky.

picks.title: Picks
picks.text: This page is full of picks: a song, a person, a quote, a goal and more. They change every week.
picks.try: Pick one thing here and notice why it speaks to you.

about-me.title: About me
about-me.text: A short hello from the person who started Rebella, in her own words. It's why the site exists.

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.text: A preview of the Rebella newsletter sign-up. Nothing is sent yet, and nothing you type is saved.

create-type.title: Board type
create-type.text: Choose a mood board, a collage or a vision board. Each one has a slightly different feel.
create-type.try: Choose the one that feels right, not the one that looks hardest.

create-bg.title: Background colour
create-bg.text: Sets the colour behind your board. Tap a swatch or pick any colour you like.

create-tabs.title: Stickers, photos and words
create-tabs.text: Switch between stickers, photos and text. Tap or drag things onto your board.

create-text.title: Your words
create-text.text: Type a short phrase, up to 80 letters, then add it to your board.
create-text.try: Write one word you want more of this week.

create-font.title: Font
create-font.text: Changes the style of your words, from neat to handwritten to bold.

create-tools.title: Arrange tools
create-tools.text: Move a picked item forward or back, copy it, add a white frame or delete it.

create-save.title: Save
create-save.text: Saves your board in this browser on this device, so it's here next time. It isn't sent anywhere.

create-download.title: Download
create-download.text: Saves your board as a picture on your device, ready to print or keep.

create-clear.title: Clear
create-clear.text: Empties your board so you can start again.

board.title: Your board
board.text: This is your canvas. Drag things around, pinch or use the handles to resize, and make it yours. There's no right or wrong board.

escape.title: Get me out
escape.text: If you ever need to leave fast, tap this. It jumps straight to the Rebella home page.

footer-links.title: More from Rebella
footer-links.text: Links to every section, plus places you can get help any time, like Kids Helpline on 1800 55 1800, ReachOut and headspace.

help-orb.title: The help orb
help-orb.text: That's me. I'm the only way to ask questions here. Drag me onto anything and I'll explain it up top and down below.
